key_path: zero-account: `npx wrangler deploy --temporary` provisions a temporary account, issues Wrangler an API token and prints a claim URL (60-minute lifetime). No human needed

permanent account (fastest): `stripe projects init` / `stripe projects add cloudflare/...`: Stripe acts as IdP and provisions the Cloudflare account + API token; human accepts ToS (and confirms payment only if needed)
or classic: sign up at dash.cloudflare.com (email + password, Turnstile, email verification), then `wrangler login` (OAuth browser, scope selection)
API token: dashboard > My Profile > API Tokens (user) or Manage Account > API Tokens (account-owned), template or custom permissions
MCP: `claude mcp add --transport http cloudflare https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp` then OAuth, or pass an API token as bearer
human_gates: email_verification + captcha (Turnstile) on classic dashboard signup

agent_native_auth.cli_device_flow: yes: `wrangler login` OAuth browser flow with selectable scopes (localhost callback, not device code)
agent_native_auth.mcp_oauth_dcr: yes: https://mcp.cloudflare.com/register (also on per-product servers, e.g. bindings.mcp.cloudflare.com/register)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes: API tokens (user and account-owned) can be created via the API by a token with token-write permission. Stripe Projects protocol provisions account + token for agents (2026-04-30); Cloudflare co-designed auth.md for agent account provisioning
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes: very fine-grained per-permission and per-zone/account tokens with IP and TTL filters
agent_native_auth.claimable_anonymous: yes: `wrangler deploy --temporary` (blog 2026-06-19) creates a temp account + API token + claim URL. Covers Workers, sites, APIs, databases and bindings. Auto-deleted after 60 minutes unless claimed. Wrangler advertises the flag to unauthenticated agents

remote.auth: OAuth (DCR) or user/account API token as bearer

mcp.remote_others: docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp (docs, no auth), containers., browser., dex., casb., bindings.mcp.cloudflare.com, agents.cloudflare.com/mcp (Agents SDK docs)
mcp.local: not needed; Cloudflare Skills plugin bundles the MCP servers
mcp.type: product (the whole 2,500+ endpoint API via 2 code-mode tools) + docs MCP
mcp.one_click: Cloudflare Skills plugin via marketplaces; per-agent guides at developers.cloudflare.com/agent-setup/ (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, Devin, VS Code...)

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes: /index.md on every page, 'Copy as Markdown' / 'View as Markdown' and an 'Agent setup' link on each page

autonomy_note: Temporary account gives a real API token with no human. A permanent account via Stripe Projects needs only ToS acceptance (~3 min).
score_justification: The only company here where an agent gets a real API token and deploys with zero human steps. It also has a full-API code-mode MCP with DCR or token auth, fine-grained tokens that can be minted via API, and agent-provisioned accounts via Stripe.
best_practice: `wrangler deploy --temporary`: a temporary account + scoped token + claim URL, advertised by the CLI itself when an agent is unauthenticated
biggest_gap: The classic dashboard signup is still behind a JS challenge, Turnstile and email verification, and the many separate product MCP servers fragment discovery (mitigated by the unified mcp.cloudflare.com)
